chart.description: Shared containers, tooltips, time-series and donut compositions with stable colors and accessible values.
chart.longName: A deliberately long edge function service category name for wrapping and accessible labels
chart.incomplete: A source is missing. The neutral track represents unassigned totals; ratios are unavailable.
chart.guidance: TimeSeriesChart preserves null gaps and requires locale/timeZone and the actual window domain. DonutSummary retains unassigned totals on a neutral track. Data tables are keyboard accessible. Use chartColor(1) for a main series and fixed slots for comparisons; chartSeriesColor(id) provides a stable five-slot fallback. Share the resolved color with legends. Status colors remain independent.
